fields.topic: Realized mass, volume and practical fabrication
fields.finding: Actual integer counts add 178.319 kg of tube mass to the selected continuum point and leave 174.444 kg closure deficit at the 5% reserve. Resizing closes the declared arithmetic, but the cap sag and pressure-fan surfaces are distinct approximations. Film mass uses 4 pi R squared; node and systems allowances are inherited.
fields.needed: Manufactured curved-tube tolerances and joints, gas-barrier/adhesive/seam/attachment mass, continuous or segmented arc feasibility, a pressure-equilibrated volume, assembly access, damage protection and a complete bill of materials.
fields.prohibited_inference: Near-zero numerical closure residual does not establish physical vehicle mass closure.
